# RANDOM.ORG Maker Tools

> A no-code platform for creating and sharing interactive randomizers, educational tools, and probability demonstrations.

RANDOM.ORG Maker Tools enables users to build custom randomizers without coding, from literary quote generators to gambling simulators and probability visualizations. The platform serves educators, students, and enthusiasts interested in randomness, statistics, and interactive learning.

## Key Topics

- No-code platform

## Getting Started

- [Maker Tools - RANDOM.ORG](https://make.random.org): RANDOM.ORG Maker Tools: no-code platform for creating randomizers and educational tools

## Featured Randomizers

- [Random Quotes from Ulysses](https://make.random.org/caea65aaf241333b): James Joyce Ulysses quote randomizer tool featuring Leopold Bloom passages
- [Three-Reel Slot Machine](https://make.random.org/07eb08e2e734a044): Three-reel slot machine randomizer with frequency analysis capabilities
- [Liberty Bell Slot Machine](https://make.random.org/295ae54a65791abe): Liberty Bell slot machine randomizer and gambling simulator tool
- [Colored Disc Randomizer](https://make.random.org/adf601fac725a793): Interactive colored disc randomizer demonstrating probability and frequency

## Community Randomizers

- [Randomizers by Test Account 11](https://make.random.org/list/8860): Collection of user-created randomizers including slot machine simulators
